cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: How Much Do You Know?
cards.instruction: Probe for what others know while revealing as little as possible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. What did the manager say about the missing keys?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They might be in the drain. You locked up, didn't you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Is she asking everyone who locked up, or just me?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Just you. Someone saw you outside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Did they say what I was doing, or only where I was?

mechanism: A corrects speculative location and witness claims as a professional while finding out exactly what the manager knows about A missing-key involvement.
confusable: A denial would disclose a position; this Drive asks precision questions without admitting or denying the relevant act.
comparison: Party alternative concerns a reported recording; keys scene separates someone seeing A outside from seeing an incriminating action.
seedUse: Missing-key seed supplies manager attribution and outside witness; S03 specificity turns speculation into a corrected evidential category.
